title: Panda to Bear
description: Changes panda textures to brown bear
body:
I made this pack that is turning pandas to brown bears (it also changes some sounds).

They all look really cute.

Agressive Bear
Playful Bear
Brown Bear
Worred Bear
Lazy Bear
Weak Bear
Bear

Changed Sounds:
- death sounds
- cant_breed sounds
